name: Ken'zigla's Draught
summary: In the Horde warlock chain to summon a succubus, Ken'zigla's Draught is bound for Camp Taurajo. The troll apothecary prepared it in the Stonetalon Mountains to save Dogran, a missing operative.

sections.title: A Life-Saving Brew
sections.body: Ken'zigla prepared a second dose after trouble with the first courier. The troll apothecary in the Stonetalon Mountains feared the emissary sent to find medicine for the missing scout Dogran had never returned. His draught is volatile and powerful. Half a dose gives a mortally wounded soldier strength to move without making the wounds bleed anew. The rest must wait until the next day, when it completes the recovery.

sections.title: Rendezvous at Camp Taurajo
sections.body: You carry Ken'zigla's draught from the mountains to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo. Logmar has vital intelligence about Dogran's whereabouts, but foraging expeditions have left his garrison short of grunts. Dogran is trapped and bleeding in hostile territory; the draught's arrival at Taurajo brings a rescue operation close.

faq.q: What is Ken'zigla's Draught meant to do?
faq.answer: Ken'zigla's draught is a potent medicine meant to revive the injured orc operative Dogran. Given in two doses, the first gives a wounded fighter strength to move without reopening mortal wounds, and the second completes the healing.
Ken'zigla is a troll apothecary in the Stonetalon Mountains. He prepares specialized alchemical mixtures for Horde agents in the region.

faq.q: Why is Grunt Logmar waiting at Camp Taurajo?
faq.answer: Grunt Logmar is stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He tracks local scout movements and holds the last known intelligence about where Dogran disappeared, but lacks the grunts to mount a rescue alone.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to summoning a succubus?
faq.answer: Horde warlocks in Orgrimmar need Dogran's pendant, an artifact suffused with passion and devotion, to summon and bind a succubus. They must find Dogran and save his life with Ken'zigla's draught to secure it.

faq.q: Why didn't the first courier bring the draught?
faq.answer: The first messenger sent to Stonetalon never completed the mission. Ken'zigla prepared a backup dose for the next traveler searching for Dogran.

faq.q: Where does the trail go after Camp Taurajo?
faq.answer: After receiving the draught, Grunt Logmar directs you to Dogran's captors in the southern Barrens, where the dying scout is held hostage.

angles.text: As a warlock, you must show patience and resourcefulness on this leg of your journey. Before you can command a creature of raw desire and seduction, you must mend the injured mortal who carries the token of binding.
As a member of the Horde, you see how isolated outposts in Stonetalon and the Barrens rely on travelers to carry vital messages and medical aid across central Kalimdor.
